content: Mabaygaw pawa midh, gegeyadh ayman lawnga midh, mina yoepathaman a kapu akasin

Kalanu Yesu nuydh muynu ngurpan nungu niyay kazil kedha, ‘Mabaygiya nuthayl zapul ngaru dhadha mangemipu, mabaygal adhapa ruwamoeypa, kasa kay kedha nuy nga nanga yabugud, kedha ngoedhal wati zapa, nuydh bangal koey gegeyadh gasamoene.

Nagemiw moegina kaz koeygarsar, a matha kedha mabaygal ngaya nanga koey ngulaygal lawnga; thana adhapa yoelpayg sethabi wati yabugudoepa. Koey gegeyadh bangal thanamun yoelpayzi mabaygoepa, nubepa matha ngoedhagidh kedha nubiya koey kula katanu thayan a malunu dudupan.
‘Ngitha ngaru danal poethaypa ngithamun mab. ‘Nginu tukuyap na wati pawa, ngidh nuyn gar ngalkan; nuydh nanga senabi wati pawa wanan, a garthil thayan, wa, balbayginga, ngidh ngaru gud wayan nuyn

Nuydh nanga lak ayman, a kalanu lak garthil thayan, wa ngidh nubepa lak guythuyan nginu ngoenakapoengu. Seben thonaralnga urapun goeyginu nanga nuydh ayman a mura thonara nuy ngapa ngibepa a kedha muliz, “Ngay garthi thayiz nubi wati pawangu.” Wa, ngidh ngaru guythuyan nungu wati pawa seben thonaralnga.’
Kalanu thana niyay kazil kedha mulaydhin, ‘Kuykulnga, ngidh bangal koesimoene ngoeymun mina yoepathaman.’

Yesu kuniya mulaydhin thanamulpa kedha, ‘Nginu na mina yoepathaman mina za nanga kasa midh moegina, ngoedhe bupaw moegina kapu midh nanga, wa, ngi ngulayg koey puypa muliz, “Puy, ngi boeradharoengu adhapa soeyzi malupa.” A nuydh puyn ayman nginu ubilnga.’

Kalanu Yesu lak ngurpay aymoedhin thanamulpa kedha, ‘Ngithamulngu nanga wara mabayg zagethaw maoebaygoelayg, ngithamulpa matha ngoedhagidh nuydh mi zageth ayman? Mamu nungu apaw poepathay zageth, lawnga mamuy danal poethay, kuniya na lagoepa tidiz nanga, kedha lawnga kedha nginu zagethaw mabayg kulay thayan aypa.

Na pawa kedha, kuyku mabayg muliz nungu zagethaw mabaygoepa kedha, “Ayde ngayapa buth pathamay, a ngi nginu geth buth pathi, a ngaw ayde ngukil kay yawaymidha. Sew kalanu kay ngidh nginu aygud gasamar a nguki.”
Sena nungu zagethaw mabaygaw zageth, nuydh kedha aymoeypa, nuy zagethaw kuyk eso poeybayginga.

‘Wa, ngitha lak kedha Awgadhaw zagethaw mabaygal, ngitha nanga zageth ayman mura nungu ubilnga nungu yangukuduya; wa, ngi ngibiya muynu kedha, “In ngay kasa nungu zagethaw mabayg, ayman nungu ubilnga; mura zagethaw mabaygaw pawa midh nanga.” ’
Ten wati goengawl kikirilgal balbay tidamoeyn
Yesun mab matha ulaypu Yoerusalemoepa, nungu yabugud dhadhiya pudhaydhin ukasar koey goegath, Galilaya boedha doegamoenu a Samariya getha doegamoenu.
Nuy na ngapa mudhaw lagoepa woelmay, nubepa ngapa ten wati goengaw kikirilgal. Thana koey sigaz
wal tiduman kedha, ‘Yesu! Kuykulnga! Ngidh gar koerkak badh gasamar ngoeymulpa.’

Yesu nuydh imiz, a thanamulpa kedha muliz, ‘Ngithamun misnarepa ladhu, thana kay ngitha zoeyzi noeydhemipa.’ Wa, thana ladhudhin, thanamun maboenu thanamun gamunu badhal pupumoeydhin, mura balbayginga.
Matha urapun mabayg thanamulngu Yesulpa kuniya tidaydhin, nuydh nanga imadhin kedha nuy balbayginga nungu kikiringu; a nuy gima gudiya thawmadhin Awgadh.
Nuy nanga Yesuniya mangaydhin, nuy apa pudhaydhin boeradharoepa Yesun siyara apal, a koeyma eso poeybaydhin. Senabi mabayg nuy Yoewdhayaw mabayg lawnga, nuy Samariyalayg.
Yesu nuyn mabayg thawmadhin kedha, ‘Setha wara nayn mabaygal ngalaga, setha mura ten balbayg asimoeynu a?
Ina imaw, dhuray ngapa kuniya tidayginga eso poeybaypa Awgadhoepa, a thawmaypa. Matha in urapun ngapa wara goegathaw mabayg koeyma eso poeybema.’
Yesu nubepa kedha mulaydhin, ‘Wa, ngi kaday tari a uzar, ngin mura buth pathan kuyk nginu mina yoepathaman.’
Awgadhaw Kupay bangal midh paru, a Nungu Basalaya

Wara thonara thana Parasayalgal Yesulpa yapu poeybemidhin kedha, ‘Awgadhaw Basalaya a nungu kupay midh thonara bangal imane?’ Nungu Yesun kuniya ya kedha, ‘Awgadhaw Basalaya mabaygan purkan imayginga,

A mabaygoepa kedha mulaypa lawnga, “E! Imaw, kupay lag Awgadhaw, ina.” Lawnga wara sena, “E! Sepa nagemiw, Awgadhaw kupay lag.” Na kedha zoenguz kedha, Awgadhaw niyay lag in kayib ngithamuniya dhadhal.’

Kalanu nuy buwayl thayadhin nungu niyay kazipa kedha, ‘Nan bangal thonar gasamoene kedha, Mabaygaw Kazi lak ngithamuniya mayginga, a ngithamun koey ubi senabi thonarpa gasamoeypa ngithamulpa purkaw gasamoeypa Mabaygaw Kazipa, kasa kay imayginga.
Mabaygoepa kurusipoegayg kedha, “Mabaygaw Kazi sey.” Lawnga wara mabayg kedha, “In nuy.” Lawnga gurguy zoelmayg mabaygiya oesig.
Mabaygaw Kaziw kuniya mangay thonara nanga gasamoene, ngoedhe poenipoeniw buyadh bangal zilamidhe dapara gimal wara gizungu wara gizupa.
‘Wagel kay bangal thabi zapul aymoeyne, kulay nuydh koeyma gegeyadh gasamoene, a nubi maykuyku mabaygan nuyn adhapa imane.
Wagel bangal nungu ngapa kuniya mangay, matha kedha Nowan thonar midh nanga,

mabaygan ay saran poegaypu, garkazil ipin poeybepu, a yoepkazil alaypa mamayipu, kurusipa senabi goeyginu Nowa uzaraydhin nungu koey butoepa muypa. Kalanu woer wayaydhin nubi apa goewaya a mura thoerpumaydhin, mura zapul uma mathamoeydhin.

‘Wa, Mabaygaw Kaziw kuniya mangay kedha kuniya, gumi za mabaygal kulay koerawaygal. Matha kedha Lothan thonar midh nanga, mabaygan ay saran poegaypu zapul sakariya idimpu, nagul uthumoeypu, a lagal moeydhamoeypu.
Senabi goeyga, Lothan mabaygal koerngaylmayl, thana ladhudhin Sodomoengu. Kalanu koey muy a salpa ngapa daparoengu mulupa, mura mathamoeydhin Sodomaw mabaygal.
Kedha ngoedhalnga Mabaygaw Kazi bangal yakamidhe senabi goeyginu.

‘Senabi thonara mabayg nanga lagaw thodhanu gimal thanuriz gabupa, na matha ngoedhagidh lawnga nubepa mulupa maypa zapa gasamoeypa; matha kedha ngoedhalnga, mabayg nga zagethaw lagoenu adhal, koey zageth kuniya tidiz lagoepa. Matha ngoedhagidh ngi ngaru sobaginga.
Ngoenanu manin Lothan ipiw Kuth.
Mabaygan nanga nuydh nungu igililnga kaludhan, lawnga na gegeyadh nuydh guythuyan, a nga nanga sagul palan nungu igililnga mabaygoepa, wa nuydh bangal gasaman nungu igililnga.
‘Senabi kubilu bangal mabaygaw kuth yaynanob, ukasar mabayg nanga urapun uthuy lagoenu muynu; wara mabayg palamulngu balbayginga adhapa yoelpan a wara kasa wanan.
Zagethaw lagoenu lak kedha; ukasar yoepkaziw kunaw aymay zageth kalmel, palamulngu wara balbayginga adhapa yoelpan Mabaygaw Kazipa a wara na kuniya wanan.’

Kalanu nungu niyay kazil nubepa kedha yapupoeybaydhin, ‘Kuykulnga, sethabi zapul bangal ngalaga?’ Nuy kuniya kedha mulaydhin thanamulpa, ‘Senabi thonara bangal kakal, ngoedhe uruyn nurimpa gibidhoepa.’

footnotes.text: Nowan zageth: wara Zenesis 6.5-8 geth tidi.
Lothan ipiw ya gidha, wara Zenesis 19.26 geth tidi.

Dhuray kulkubaw Minar Poelayzimayl, thana wara basalmayl kedha: 36 Ukasar mabayg nanga kalmel zagethan memampa apaw lagoenu, thana ngaw garwoeydhamayzi angelal sepa nanga palamulpa, thana ngulayg wara mabayg oengane a wara mabayg kasa wanan.
